paper_id: Backward and Forward Language Modeling for Constrained Sentence Generation
title: Backward and Forward Language Modeling for Constrained Sentence Generation
motivation: 现有语言模型无法保证生成句子中包含指定词汇,这限制了问答等实际应用
problem_framing: 将约束词作为根节点,通过贝叶斯网络分解联合概率生成前后文
key_insight: 从给定词同时向两端生成,无需首词约束即可保证该词出现在任意位置
method_signature: 双向/异步B/F RNN语言模型,基于GRU的条件概率乘积分解
evaluation_criteria: 科学论文标题的困惑度,以及生成文本的定性质量比较
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: 所有B/F变体困惑度均高于顺序模型,sep-B/F过于贪婪且生成内容过短
evidence_for_taste: existing approaches could not solve this problem
All B/F variants yield a larger perplexity
the sep-B/F model is too greedy
generating short and general texts is a known issue
Randomly choosing a split word increases uncertainly
thinking_moves: 将句子联合概率的分解方式从单向链改为双向分支结构
比较同步生成与异步生成两种变体的信息整合效果
承认随机分词带来的困惑度代价是可接受的工程权衡
用oracle设置验证约束词已知时模型的实际能力上限
cites_own_work: Lili Mou, Ge Li, L. Zhang et al. - tree-based convolution for programming language
Lili Mou, H. Peng, Ge Li et al. - discriminative neural sentence modeling
